concerns.text: T013 (Download) is marked [P] (parallel) but explicitly depends on T014 (Validation) which must run first. A task cannot be parallel-safe if it has a hard sequential dependency on another task in the same phase. T013 must be unmarked [P] or T014 must be moved to Phase 2.

T055 (lifecycle_manager cron trigger) is marked [P] but depends on T009 (lifecycle hooks) and T005 (logging) to function. The cron script cannot execute logic that relies on uninitialized logging or hooks. T055 must be unmarked [P] and placed after T009.

Phase 7 (Teleological Interpretation) tasks T052-T056 are listed as a separate phase but depend on US3 (T037) and US2 (T027) outputs. The 'Independent Test' for Phase 7 requires a list of significant events from US3. The ordering implies Phase 7 can start after Foundational, but the dependency notes correctly state it requires US3 completion. The phase header 'Independent Test' is misleading as it cannot run independently of US3 results.

T019 (Artifact Manifest) description states it must run after T021 (Lifecycle Manifest), but T021 is listed *after* T019 in the task list. The visual ordering contradicts the explicit dependency note. T021 should precede T019 in the list.
